name: Ikinari Mujintou!?
source:
Uninhabited island. Blue sky, coral sea and white sand beach. Our ship sunk and we were drifted to it. All we can do is wait for help. 
But just waiting is boring. There is even a girl who always wanted to live like this once. Anyway, our uninhabited island life begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
无人岛、蓝天、珊瑚海与白色沙滩。我们的船沉没后，众人漂流到了这里，能做的只有等待救援。

可是，光等着实在太无聊了。队伍里甚至还有个女孩一直想体验一次这样的生活。总之，我们的无人岛生活就此开始。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
